faqs.a:
(a)
As used in this article, the following words and phrases shall have the following
               meanings:
Attach
means the connection, as authorized by the authority or city clerk, of any of the
               liquor licensed premises identified in C.R.S. 44-3-301(11)(c)(II), as amended, to
               an adjoining common consumption area to provide alcohol beverages for consumption
               within the common consumption area.
Certified promotional association or promotional association
means a promotional association that has been authorized by the authority.
Colorado Liquor Code
means C.R.S. tit. 44, arts. 3, 4, and 5, as amended.
Common consumption area
means an area as defined in C.R.S. § 44-3-103(11), as amended, where persons 21 years
               of age and older may consume alcoholic beverages outside of a liquor licensed premises.
Entertainment district
shall have the same meaning as in C.R.S. § 44-3-103(15).
Evidence of community support
means any of the following forms of documentation:
(1)
A letter of community support or non-opposition;
(2)
A document indicating community support or non-opposition;
(3)
A good neighbor agreement; or
(4)
Any other evidence of community support deemed sufficient by the city clerk.
Licensee
means a certified promotional association that has been issued a common consumption
               area license under the terms of this article.
Liquor license
means a license issued pursuant to the Colorado Liquor Code for the sale of fermented
               malt beverages or malt, vinous, or spirituous liquors.
Promotional association
shall have the same meaning as in C.R.S. § 44-3-103(39), as amended.
(
Ord. No. 4804
, § 1, 6-6-2022)
